career_ladder.note: Recruitment through the UKSSSC Graduate Level Examination feeds into Group 'C' executive, administrative, and developmental positions across Uttarakhand state government departments, primarily the Rural Development Department (Village Development Officer / VDO), Panchayati Raj Department (Village Panchayat Development Officer / VPDO), Social Welfare Department, and Commission subordinate offices. Career progression in rural development and panchayati raj ascends to block and district executive ranks under Uttarakhand state cadre service rules.

exam_scheme.note: The UKSSSC Graduate Level Service Examination scheme is formally approved by the Government of Uttarakhand Personnel and Vigilance Department vide Order No. 426609/XXX(4)/2026-03(03)/26-E-94441 dated 25 August 2026. The examination comprises a single 100-mark objective written test followed by a qualifying computer typing test for posts where typing is prescribed.

financial_package.note: Graduate level recruits are appointed into Group 'C' posts across Pay Level 4 (₹25,500 - ₹81,100) for Village Development Officers (VDO) and Village Panchayat Development Officers (VPDO), and Pay Level 5 (₹29,200 - ₹92,300) for Assistant Social Welfare Officers under the Uttarakhand State Revised Pay Rules (adapting 7th Pay Commission). Entry basic pay corresponds to Level 4 benchmark ₹25,500.
financial_package.pay_source_label: UKSSSC Graduate Level Official Post Specifications & Uttarakhand State Pay Rules
financial_package.estimate_note: Gross remuneration computed on Level 4 Entry Basic Pay of ₹25,500 with Dearness Allowance at canonical 58% (₹14,790), House Rent Allowance ranging from 9% (₹2,295 in rural blocks/remote mountain stations) to 18% (₹4,590 in urban headquarters such as Dehradun), Fixed Medical Allowance (₹1,000/month), and admissible Hill Compensatory Allowance (HCA) for designated high-altitude mountain blocks. In-hand estimate accounts for statutory National Pension System (NPS) deduction of 10% of Basic + DA (₹4,029) and Uttarakhand State Employees GIS (~₹200).
official_perks: House Rent Allowance (HRA) at 9% to 18% based on posting classification, or government quarter allotment
Hill Compensatory Allowance (HCA) admissible for notified mountain districts and remote hill postings
Fixed Medical Allowance (FMA) of ₹1,000/month or coverage under Uttarakhand State Health Schemes (USHS)
Traveling Allowance (TA) and Daily Allowance (DA) for official field tours within gram panchayat circles
Contributory pension coverage under National Pension System (NPS)
Earned leave, casual leave, and medical leave benefits under Uttarakhand Leave Rules
